_about: Los Angeles preliminary cost inputs. Null means not priced. Published figures and Team assumptions are distinguished in notes; partial totals omit work and are not full project budgets.
_notice: This is a preliminary evidence review, not a legal or code determination. Final decisions are made by LADBS and licensed professionals.

sprinklers.install.excludes: No separate high-rise package, water-service capacity expansion or extraordinary access allowance is established. Confirm included engineering, testing, pumps and tanks with the contractor.
sprinklers.install.notes: Source reports approximately $3-$7/sqft for LA commercial retrofits. Team assumption: midpoint $5; treat the published range as including a 30% soft-cost allowance and divide by 1.30 before adding scenario soft costs. This allocation is not a contractor breakdown. No time or location adjustment; publication date unavailable. Confirm scope before budgeting.

sprinklers.verify_coverage.unpriced_reason: Coverage survey needs a site-specific fire-protection quote; installation rates do not price a survey.

fire_alarm.install.unpriced_reason: No isolated Los Angeles retrofit alarm rate verified; the bundled conversion benchmark includes multiple systems.

seismic.evaluate.unpriced_reason: Engineering investigation scope and testing are not known; obtain a structural engineer quote.

seismic.strengthen.unpriced_reason: Structural system and strengthening design are unknown; no building-specific rate established.

highrise.systems.unpriced_reason: Package scope is unresolved with A; pumps may overlap sprinkler installation and must be separated before pricing.

egress.add_stair.unpriced_reason: No per-story Los Angeles conversion rate isolated from structural and enclosure work.

escape.add_openings.unpriced_reason: Opening size, wall construction and structural work are unknown; a per-opening quote is needed.

elevator.upgrade.unpriced_reason: Equipment, shaft and modernization scope need an elevator contractor quote.

separation.wall_upgrade.unpriced_reason: Wall assembly, height and access are not known; no defensible linear-foot rate established.

historic.review.unpriced_reason: Review scope and consultant hours need a project-specific quote.

units.fitout.unpriced_reason: Published Los Angeles conversion totals bundle kitchens, bathrooms, MEP, soft costs and contingency; no nonoverlapping residual rate established.

units.bathroom.excludes: New building footprint, new central risers and main utility capacity work are outside this proxy. Multifamily repetition and accessibility requirements are not separately quantified.
units.bathroom.notes: Source is an all-in full bathroom addition within an existing LA house footprint. Team assumption: use as a conversion proxy; midpoint $37,500; allocate a 30% soft-cost allowance by dividing by 1.30. No inflation or location adjustment. Local bathroom plumbing stays in this line; do not also price it as a plumbing run.

units.kitchen.unpriced_reason: Residential kitchen remodel guides do not isolate new conversion kitchenettes from fit-out and utility work.

units.plumbing_run.unpriced_reason: Bathroom allowance includes local connections; separate trunk and riser lengths, routing and capacity need a quote.

soft_cost_share.notes: City CDBG construction guidance p.11 recommends adding 30% to construction estimates. Team assumption: low 25%, high one-third; reuse the 2022 ratio unchanged in 2026. Published 25% of a total is one-third of hard cost, not 25% of hard cost. Do not include financed acquisition or interest here.

contingency.notes: City CDBG rehabilitation guidance p.11 gives 15%-20%. Team assumption: midpoint 17.5%; reuse ratio unchanged in 2026 and apply it to hard plus soft cost as specified by the project formula. This does not fund omitted line items.

months_to_convert.notes: Team assumption: community-center schedule proxy, not an office conversion forecast: 12 months design + 3-4 bidding + 6-18 construction = 21-34 months, midpoint 27.5. Reuse 2022 durations unchanged in 2026. Replace with a site-specific schedule; permitting and lease-up may extend it.

occupancy.notes: AECOM LA adaptive reuse analysis Table 5 p.17 uses 5% vacancy, giving typical occupancy 95%. Team assumption: 90%-98% sensitivity band; no time adjustment to the 2024 typical in 2026. No lease-up ramp.

operating_cost_share.notes: AECOM LA adaptive reuse analysis Table 5 p.17 uses 30% operating expense ratio. Team assumption: 25%-35% sensitivity band; reuse the 2024 ratio unchanged in 2026. Interest, acquisition and capital replacements are outside this simple model.
